instruction.text: Find the fraction of the number.

atoms.a: George has 10 pens in his pencil case. 1/5 of them are black. How many pens in George’s pencil case are black?
atoms.b: To get 1/5 of 10, 10 has to be divided by 5.

wrong.text: Remember to divide the number by the denominator.

instruction.text: Find the fraction of the number.

atoms.a: Andrea has 6 dog treats. She feeds 1/2 of her treats to her dog. How many treats did the dog get?
atoms.b: To get 1/2 of 6, 6 has to be divided by 2.

wrong.text: Remember to divide the number by the denominator.

instruction.text: Find the fraction of the number.

atoms.a: Colin spent £8 in the fast food restaurant. He spent 1/4 of the money on chips. How much were the chips?
atoms.b: To get 1/4 of £8, £8 has to be divided by 4.

wrong.text: Remember to divide the number by the denominator.

instruction.text: Find the fraction of the number.

atoms.a: Athira has 15 colouring pencils. She gives 1/3 of them to her best friend. How many did she give away?
atoms.b: To get 1/3 of 15, 15 has to be divided by 3.

wrong.text: Remember to divide the number by the denominator.

instruction.text: Find the fraction of the number.

atoms.a: There are 40 horses in the stables. 1/10 have brown hair. How many horses have brown hair?
atoms.b: To get 1/10 of 40, 40 has to be divided by 10.
